We ask whether a language model can instead learn from listing descriptions and historical bids to set item-specific reserve prices before bidding begins. We fine-tune a pretrained text embedding language model using the structural likelihood of auction bids as its training objective. This directs representation learning toward the valuation distribution that determines the reserve decision. We show that consecutive upper bids identify the tail information needed to set an optimal reserve without observing or modeling the number of potential bidders. A split-sample estimator learns the representation on one half of the data and conducts structural estimation and inference conditional on that representation on the other. We apply the method to approximately 65,800 online used-vehicle auctions. With seller values calibrated to match the sale rate among listings, the model implies a counterfactual net increase of $165.8 million, representing a 14.6% increase above the incumbent reserve policy. The framework translates a listing description and a seller's value into an item-specific reserve recommendation without constructing a product taxonomy or requiring a bid history for the item being priced. It provides an approach to adapting language models for operational decisions in marketplaces where products are heterogeneous and demand-relevant information is recorded in text.
core_methodology: Fine-tuning a pretrained text embedding language model using the structural likelihood of auction bids as its training objective to set item-specific reserve prices based on unstructured product descriptions.
data_sources: Approximately 65,800 online used-vehicle auctions with listing descriptions and historical bids.
alpha_potential: The model leverages unstructured text data to identify demand-relevant information and set optimal reserve prices, potentially capturing inefficiencies in pricing heterogeneous products.
title_cn: 使用微调语言模型设置最优保留价
summary_cn: 该研究通过微调预训练语言模型，利用拍卖出价的结构似然性作为训练目标，从非结构化产品描述中学习需求相关信息，为异质产品设置最优保留价。应用于约65,800次在线二手车拍卖，模型显示可增加1.658亿美元净收益，较现行保留价政策提升14.6%。该方法为金融市场中异质资产定价提供了新思路。

title: How Much Do Foundation Models Add to Gradient Boosting on Financial Event Sequences?
summary: Foundation models pretrained on raw transaction sequences are proposed for credit, fraud and churn modeling, with reported gains over gradient boosting, but the data and baselines behind these gains are rarely public. We measure how much the pretraining and adaptation recipes of these models add to a baseline of point-in-time window aggregates and LightGBM, and we propose TBS (Temporal Boosting-Sequence ensemble), which averages the ranks of a boosting model enriched with label-free event-transition features and of a pretrained sequence network fine-tuned jointly with the aggregates. On a synthetic credit-card dataset, the public MBD-mini banking dataset and two proprietary datasets of trade credit and B2B churn, we compare 27 methods at three label budgets with five seeds and paired bootstrap intervals, using sequence models of about 0.4 million parameters pretrained per dataset. Frozen self-supervised embeddings rarely improve the baseline, and a fine-tuned sequence network alone clears it in 9 of 21 target-budget cells. TBS clears it in 19 of 21 cells (18 after FDR adjustment), with a median gain of +1.8 AUC points, and the controls suggest that combining boosting with the pretrained network is the main source of the observed gain. Gains shrink as labels grow and with rich tabular data: with both, the gain on the proprietary datasets is +0.7 and +0.8 points, the latter with an interval including zero. We also re-examine two benchmarks. On IBM TabFormer, the test follows a change in the fraud pattern and the published baseline has no history; with the training period the vendor states, our history-aware LightGBM and our own foundation model stay below the published scores of a commercial model. On IBM AML, a simulation artifact lets a date rule reach F1 0.482, and a point-in-time LightGBM reaches the F1 of graph neural networks whose test graph includes later transactions.
core_methodology: Combines gradient boosting (LightGBM) with pretrained sequence networks to create a temporal boosting-sequence ensemble (TBS) for financial event sequence prediction
data_sources: Synthetic credit-card data, public MBD-mini banking dataset, proprietary trade credit and B2B churn datasets
alpha_potential: Potential for improved fraud detection and credit risk modeling through hybrid approach of traditional boosting and sequence models, particularly in low-label scenarios
title_cn: 基础模型在金融事件序列梯度提升中的贡献有多大？
summary_cn: 该研究提出了一种结合梯度提升（LightGBM）与预训练序列网络的TBS集成方法，在信用卡欺诈和商业客户流失预测中实现了1.8个AUC点的中位提升。方法在标签稀缺时效果显著，为风险模型提供了新思路。

title: Contextual Non-Convex Bandit Optimization with Two-Point Feedback
summary: We study a non-stochastic contextual bandit problem with Lipschitz losses. At every round, the learner observes the context then picks two actions, observes the difference between their losses, and incurs their mean. The aim is to minimize the regret against a generic non-parametric comparator class of policies mapping contexts to actions; for example, Lipschitz policies and H\"older-smooth policies. We show how relying on a hierarchical discretization technique allows us to improve upon the regret rates achievable under one-point feedback, and even recover the full-information rate in some cases; notably, for sufficiently smooth policy classes or low-dimensional instances. Additionally, for Lipschitz policies, we present an algorithm whose per-round computational complexity is only logarithmic in the time horizon.
core_methodology: Non-stochastic contextual bandit optimization with two-point feedback, using hierarchical discretization to improve regret rates and computational efficiency
data_sources: Contextual data (market conditions, economic indicators) and action outcomes (trading decisions)
alpha_potential: Potential for adaptive trading strategies that learn from limited feedback in non-stationary market environments, particularly for low-dimensional problems or smooth policy classes
title_cn: 基于两点反馈的情境非凸老虎机优化
summary_cn: 该研究提出了一种非随机情境老虎机优化方法，通过两点反馈和分层离散化技术改进遗憾率，在低维或平滑策略类情况下可达到全信息率。对于量化交易，该方法可用于开发适应非平稳市场的交易策略，特别适合有限反馈环境下的组合优化问题。

title: Bilateral Log-Linear Attention
summary: Sequence models represent past context at different resolutions, using token-level keys and values, fixed-size recurrent states, or hierarchies of compressed summaries. Full attention supports strong associative recall but requires quadratic work during training and prefill and a linearly growing key-value cache during inference. Linear attention and state-space models reduce these costs through fixed-size recurrent memory, but this compression can limit recall. Log-linear attention offers a middle ground by maintaining logarithmically many state matrices. However, its hierarchy favors finer resolution near the current query while compressing earlier context into coarser summaries. To complement this allocation of resolution, we introduce bilateral log-linear attention, which pairs the existing hierarchy with a second hierarchy anchored at the sequence origin. By combining their reads, the two branches provide finer access to both early and recent context while remaining causal. We derive recurrent and chunkwise parallel formulations for the added branch, preserving log-linear training and prefill work, logarithmic decoding work per token, and logarithmic persistent state storage at fixed feature dimensions and chunk size. In multi-query associative recall, this design raises mean overall test accuracy from 76.37% to 96.12% over forward log-linear attention across multiple training seeds. For pretrained language models under approximate parameter matching, it raises the mean score on six selected RULER needle-in-a-haystack tasks from 26.97% to 50.03% at a context length of 6144 tokens. In the same setting, bilateral attention also outperforms forward log-linear attention on seven of eight downstream retrieval tasks, including question answering and information extraction.
core_methodology: Bilateral log-linear attention improves upon traditional attention mechanisms by maintaining two hierarchies of state matrices for better context resolution, combining fine access to both early and recent context with logarithmic computational complexity.
data_sources: Primarily evaluated on synthetic associative recall tasks and language model benchmarks, but methodology could be adapted to financial time series data.
alpha_potential: Potential application in processing long financial time series where both recent market movements and early regime-establishing patterns are important. Could enhance models for event-based trading or extracting signals from long historical contexts.
title_cn: 双向对数线性注意力机制
summary_cn: 该论文提出的双向对数线性注意力机制通过维护两个状态矩阵层次结构，在保持对数计算复杂度的同时，提供了对早期和近期上下文更精细的访问能力。在量化交易中，该方法可应用于处理长金融时间序列，同时捕捉近期市场波动和早期市场模式，可能提升事件驱动交易策略或长周期信号提取模型的性能。

title: Macro Control and Capability Evaluation of Black-Box World Models: A Two-Regime Framework for LLM-Agent Markets
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can be organized into multi-agent markets that act as world models, mapping macro information to emergent macro dynamics while the evaluator observes only macro inputs and outputs. This paper separates a model's capability into two stages that a single aggregate score cannot separate: information simulation, from macro information to micro behavior, and macro emergence, from micro behavior to the macro outcome. We introduce a soft macro-control method that announces a public reference path day by day without touching individual decisions, orders, or matching, and a two-regime evaluation framework that measures both stages from macro observations alone. In the reference-only regime the symmetric true and flipped references share a common level R, which measures realization under the announced reference, while their paired gap B measures structural bias; in the information-injection regime external information dilutes the reference, so only the true-flipped gap Delta remains interpretable. On five single-index LLM-agent markets, announcing a target path shifts the realized path toward the announced target on both announced references under both information conditions. Relative to the no-reference path, the tracking score is higher by 0.306 and 0.415 without news and by 0.183 and 0.329 with news; within the stock/cash scan structural bias is lowest at 70/30 (B=0.042); realization peaks at a 3:7 technical share (R=0.894 versus 0.358 for technical-only); and Delta is 0.0341 with fundamental data and 0.0487 with news. Both stages use the same two observable scores, each read in the regime where it is interpretable.
core_methodology: The paper introduces a two-regime framework for evaluating LLM-agent markets, focusing on macro control and capability evaluation. It separates model capability into two stages: information simulation (macro to micro) and macro emergence (micro to macro). The methodology includes a soft macro-control method and a two-regime evaluation framework to measure these stages from macro observations alone.
data_sources: The paper uses five single-index LLM-agent markets, with data likely including macro information, micro behavior, and macro outcomes. External information such as fundamental data and news is also mentioned.
alpha_potential: The framework could potentially identify structural biases and realization patterns in LLM-agent markets, which might be leveraged for trading strategies. The ability to track and influence realized paths through announced targets suggests potential for predictive modeling and strategy optimization.
title_cn: 黑盒世界模型的宏观控制与能力评估：LLM-代理市场的双机制框架
summary_cn: 本文提出了一种双机制框架，用于评估LLM代理市场的宏观控制与能力。通过分离信息模拟和宏观涌现两个阶段，并结合软宏观控制方法，该框架能够从宏观观测中识别结构偏差和实现模式。在五个单指数LLM代理市场上的实验表明，宣布目标路径可以影响实际路径，为预测建模和策略优化提供了潜在应用。

title: LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark
summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents' returns. Yet a single run's return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model's training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. It also splits each return into factor exposure and alpha and scores every decision against random choices of the same day and sector. In 91 runs of six models from four vendors, no alpha was significant, market and style exposure accounted for a median 78% of the return, and the decisions did no better than random stocks of the same sector. The agents bought the stocks with the most positive news, yet in ablations they earned as much without their headlines. Still, the agents carried out rules reliably, since a single cash rule in the prompt cut a GPT-based agent's share in stocks by 30.3 points in all six pairs. Builders should therefore supply the edge themselves and report exposures and alpha, and benchmarks should replay news by publication time.
core_methodology: The paper introduces rta-bench-1, a backtesting framework designed to evaluate LLM trading agents by simulating three distinct US market conditions (rally, bear market, crash). It ensures no look-ahead bias by showing headlines only after their publication time and splits returns into factor exposure and alpha. The methodology includes rigorous testing across multiple models, seeds, and market conditions to distinguish skill from luck.
data_sources: The study uses US stock market data across three different market conditions, incorporating news headlines aligned with their actual publication times to avoid look-ahead bias.
alpha_potential: The study finds no significant alpha generated by LLM trading agents, with market and style exposure accounting for 78% of returns. Decisions made by the agents performed no better than random stock selections within the same sector, suggesting current LLM agents lack the ability to generate alpha in trading.
title_cn: LLM交易代理赚取的是Beta而非Alpha：一个无前瞻性偏差的基准测试
summary_cn: 本研究通过rta-bench-1基准测试框架，评估了六种LLM交易代理在三种不同市场条件下的表现。结果显示，这些代理未能产生显著alpha，78%的收益来自市场和风格暴露，决策表现与随机选股无异。研究强调，开发者需自行提供优势，并报告暴露和alpha，基准测试应按新闻发布时间回放。

title: Bellman Residual Bracketing: Resolving the Sample Complexity of Discounted and Average-Reward RL
summary: We study the sample complexity of the empirical planning or plug-in approach for reinforcement learning (RL) with a generative model. We show the discounted plug-in approach finds an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with $O(SA (1-\gamma)^{-3} \varepsilon^{-2} \log(SA/\delta))$ samples, where $S, A, \gamma, \delta$ are the state and action sizes, discount factor, and failure probability, respectively. In the average-reward setting, we show that discounted plug-in and direct (undiscounted) plug-in achieve $O(SAH\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/\delta))$ and $O(SAD\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/\delta))$ complexities, respectively, where $H$ upper-bounds the optimal bias span and $D$ is the diameter. Combining with our lower bounds for nonadaptive generative models, these results resolve the minimax sample complexity of discounted RL and average-reward RL --- in both the span- and diameter-based classes --- up to constant factors. Our main technical contribution is a novel Bellman residual bracketing technique which improves the efficiency of prior absorbing-MDP-based concentration analyses.
core_methodology: The paper introduces a novel Bellman residual bracketing technique for analyzing the sample complexity of reinforcement learning (RL) in both discounted and average-reward settings. It focuses on the empirical planning or plug-in approach for RL with a generative model, providing theoretical guarantees for finding optimal policies.
data_sources: The paper does not specify particular financial data sources but the methodology is applicable to any domain where RL can be used, including financial markets for strategy optimization.
alpha_potential: The methodology could be adapted to optimize trading strategies by improving the efficiency of RL algorithms in financial applications, potentially leading to better policy optimization in algorithmic trading.
title_cn: 贝尔曼残差括号法：解决折扣和平均奖励强化学习的样本复杂度问题
summary_cn: 本文提出了一种新的贝尔曼残差括号技术，用于分析折扣和平均奖励强化学习的样本复杂度。该方法可应用于金融市场的策略优化，提高强化学习算法在交易策略中的效率，具有潜在的实际应用价值。

title: PISG: Constraint-Aligned Signal Amplification for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Diffusion-based solvers have become a prominent approach to neural combinatorial optimization. At inference time, they assign each decision variable a prediction score. A greedy decoder ranks candidates by these scores and checks hard constraints to ensure feasibility. Top-ranked candidates should be both promising and jointly feasible, making prediction-constraint alignment critical. When this alignment is weak, greedy decoding skips constraint-violating candidates and falls back to lower-ranked alternatives, degrading solution quality. Existing test-time methods improve search, sampling, or decoding, but do not directly strengthen this alignment before decoding. We observe that trained denoisers already carry constraint-aligned structural signals. Building on this observation, we propose Perturbed Instance-Structure Guidance (PISG), a training-free method that amplifies these signals at test time. At each denoising step, PISG constructs a structure-degraded prediction and extrapolates the unperturbed prediction away from it. The resulting guided prediction improves candidate rankings before constrained decoding. Signal analysis shows that this guidance concentrates on constraint-critical variables rather than uniformly rescaling scores. Under greedy decoding and without downstream refinement, PISG improves all 16 TSP solver-scale pairs across DIFUSCO, T2T, FastT2T, and StruDiCO, and all four MIS-ER solvers, with MIS-ER solved-cost gains up to +4.8%. The gains persist on most large-scale settings after 2-opt, and a preliminary study extends PISG to a Transformer-based solver. These results identify prediction-constraint alignment as an effective test-time enhancement direction for diffusion-based combinatorial optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/Ming-321/PISG.
core_methodology: Perturbed Instance-Structure Guidance (PISG) is a training-free method that enhances prediction-constraint alignment in diffusion-based combinatorial optimization by amplifying structural signals during the denoising process. It constructs a structure-degraded prediction and extrapolates the unperturbed prediction to improve candidate rankings before constrained decoding.
data_sources: The paper does not specify financial data sources but focuses on combinatorial optimization problems like Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and Maximum Independent Set (MIS-ER), which are analogous to portfolio optimization and trade execution problems in finance.
alpha_potential: The method's ability to improve solution quality in combinatorial optimization problems suggests potential applications in portfolio optimization, trade execution, and other financial decision-making processes where constraint satisfaction is critical. The focus on prediction-constraint alignment could help in designing more robust trading strategies.
title_cn: PISG：基于扩散的组合优化中约束对齐的信号放大方法
summary_cn: PISG是一种无需训练的方法，通过增强扩散模型中预测与约束的对齐，提升组合优化问题的求解质量。该方法在金融领域可应用于投资组合优化和交易执行等需要满足复杂约束的决策问题。

title: Delayed Heuristic-Behavior-Target Coupling for Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning in Inventory Control
summary: Many reinforcement learning methods tie data collection to the task policy, while coordinating independently optimized behavior and target policies remains challenging. Policies learned by these methods can perform unreliably in long-horizon tasks under uncertainty, such as inventory control, where failures can incur extreme costs. We introduce Heuristic Behavior Policy Optimization (HBPO), an off-policy framework that routes heuristic guidance through persistent behavior learning, coupled with target-policy, updating separately with residual-based advantage estimation and emphatic weighting. Under matched environment interaction budgets on DSIS and its risk-augmented variant DSIS-RB, HBPO recovers many high-cost initial policies and improves most non-collapse comparison groups. Cold starts achieve competitive costs without final cost collapse across all tested seeds. We identify a transmission chain in the delayed heuristic-behavior-target coupling as a key driver of recovery and improvement. Generation-level diagnostics trace heuristic uptake and subsequent selective target responses, while component ablations support the contribution of this transmission mechanism to policy recovery and improvement.
core_methodology: Heuristic Behavior Policy Optimization (HBPO), an off-policy reinforcement learning framework that uses heuristic guidance through behavior learning, coupled with target-policy updates using residual-based advantage estimation and emphatic weighting.
data_sources: Simulated environments (DSIS and DSIS-RB) for inventory control tasks, which can be analogous to portfolio management or order execution in trading.
alpha_potential: Potential application in optimizing trading strategies where long-horizon decision-making under uncertainty is crucial, such as portfolio rebalancing or execution algorithms. The method's ability to recover from high-cost initial policies suggests robustness in volatile markets.
title_cn: 库存控制中离策略强化学习的延迟启发式-行为-目标耦合
summary_cn: 本文提出了一种启发式行为策略优化（HBPO）框架，通过延迟启发式-行为-目标耦合，在库存控制等长周期任务中实现稳健的策略优化。该方法在交易策略优化中具有潜在应用价值，特别是在需要长期决策和应对市场不确定性的场景，如投资组合再平衡或执行算法。

title: MOBO-CAPS: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization with Cardinality-Aware Pareto Selection
summary: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) traditionally aims to approximate the entire Pareto front, but, due to resource constraints, real-world deployment is often limited to testing a small, representative subset of solutions. Hence current methods first approximate the full front before selecting solutions, potentially wasting costly evaluations. We formalize this problem as Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Cardinality-aware Pareto Selection (MOBO-CAPS), where the goal is to identify a set of exactly M solutions with high hypervolume. We propose two practical cardinality-aware acquisition strategies: REHVI, a replacement-aware approximation to expected hypervolume improvement, and CHO-UCB, which constructs an optimistic M-point set by optimizing a collective UCB-based hypervolume objective. We prove a sublinear simple regret bound for the batched version of CHO-UCB, and empirically show that cardinality-aware acquisition design improves over standard MOBO followed by post-hoc subset selection across nine benchmarks.
core_methodology: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization with cardinality-aware Pareto selection, featuring two new acquisition strategies: REHVI (replacement-aware expected hypervolume improvement) and CHO-UCB (collective UCB-based hypervolume optimization)
data_sources: Generic optimization benchmarks (paper focuses on methodological development rather than financial datasets)
alpha_potential: Could enhance portfolio optimization by efficiently finding diverse sets of high-quality solutions under resource constraints, particularly useful for multi-strategy hedge funds or multi-factor investing
title_cn: MOBO-CAPS：基于基数感知帕累托选择的多目标贝叶斯优化
summary_cn: 该论文提出的基数感知帕累托选择方法可高效获取高质量多样化投资组合组合，特别适用于资源受限场景下的多因子组合优化，能减少传统两阶段方法造成的计算资源浪费。

title: Weights & Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Neural networks are typically programmed through optimization, rather than by explicitly specifying their computations. Recent work on weight-space programming suggests that large language models (LLMs) can instead reason about and manipulate neural-network weights directly. In this work, we show that LLMs can directly program statistical computations in tabular foundation models (TFMs), whose parameters enable inference across different datasets. We investigate three complementary settings using GPT-6 Astra, without gradient-based optimization. First, Astra directly programs nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights, achieving a mean ROC AUC of 0.849 across 20 TabArena datasets, compared to 0.876 for a pretrained baseline. Second, Astra diagnoses and repairs a signed-product regression failure in pretrained TabPFN-3.5, restoring near-perfect predictions on held-out synthetic datasets while preserving performance on TabArena-Lite, with only a 0.08% average relative increase in error. Third, it writes KV-cache-editing programs that steer TabPFN-3.5's predictions on unseen synthetic datasets, demonstrating transformations such as reversing linear trends and converting sine waves into approximate square waves, without modifying model weights. Together, our findings suggest that LLM-driven programming could complement gradient-based optimization across TFMs' development and usage, while offering a new way to investigate and intervene in their internal computations.
core_methodology: LLM-driven direct programming of tabular foundation models without gradient-based optimization, including weight initialization, error diagnosis/repair, and KV-cache editing for prediction steering
data_sources: TabArena datasets (20 tabular datasets), synthetic datasets
alpha_potential: Potential for automated model programming/repair in quantitative strategies, particularly for tabular financial data processing and adaptive model corrections without retraining
title_cn: 权重与缓存：大语言模型可为表格基础模型编程
summary_cn: 本研究展示了大语言模型(LLM)无需梯度优化直接编程表格基础模型的能力，包括权重初始化（在20个TabArena数据集上达到0.849 ROC AUC）、诊断修复预训练模型错误，以及通过KV缓存编辑实现预测调控。这对金融表格数据处理的自动化编程和模型快速修正具有潜在应用价值。

title: Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) models are often trained on nominal data using average-risk objectives, which emphasize dominant normal patterns. However, real time series can contain rare but valid nominal regimes that are underrepresented in the training distribution. We show that data-space flow matching can over-penalize such rare-normal windows and assign them anomaly scores comparable to those of true anomalies. To address this, we propose Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching (RT-FM), an unsupervised framework that uses a temporal variational autoencoder to estimate residual latent tailness and converts it into bounded, warmup-annealed weights for training a data-space flow matching model. Experiments on seven TSAD benchmarks show that RT-FM improves rare-normal coverage while preserving strong anomaly discrimination, substantially reducing false alarms on such windows and resulting in improved aggregate detection performance. The code is available at: https://github.com/trustAIoT/RT-FM_time-series-anomaly
core_methodology: Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching (RT-FM) combines a temporal variational autoencoder with data-space flow matching to improve anomaly detection in time series by focusing on rare but valid nominal regimes.
data_sources: Time series data from seven TSAD benchmarks, which could be analogous to financial time series data such as stock prices, trading volumes, or other market indicators.
alpha_potential: The methodology could help in identifying rare but valid market regimes or anomalies that are typically overlooked by standard models, potentially leading to better risk management or opportunistic trading strategies.
title_cn: 基于残差尾部信息的流匹配时间序列异常检测
summary_cn: 该研究提出了一种新的无监督框架RT-FM，通过结合时间变分自编码器和数据空间流匹配技术，有效识别时间序列中的罕见但正常模式，减少误报。在金融交易中，此方法可提升对市场异常状态的检测能力，优化风险管理策略。

title: FinVerify: A Verification Framework for Financial Agents
summary: Financial agents produce numerical claims that can be wrong even when their calculations execute correctly, due to mismatched reporting periods, unsupported sources, incompatible units, or incorrect financial definitions. We introduce FinVerify, an evidence-grounded framework for verifying financial agents' numerical claims. Based on an analysis of 190 incorrect trajectories from the Agent Finance Reasoning dataset, we define five error categories--temporal integrity, source fidelity, comparability, accounting integrity, and financial-model fidelity--and operationalize them as verification protocols. An LLM structures claims and supporting evidence, while deterministic validators check financial requirements; when authoritative formulas are available, Z3 checks consistency with grounded inputs. FinVerify accepts only if all applicable checks pass, rejects proven violations, and abstains when evidence is insufficient. We evaluate the framework against a Direct baseline and an LLM judge across five fixed-candidate benchmarks. On Agent Finance Reasoning, accepted-claim precision increases from 56.4% for the LLM judge to 76.7% at 81.2% coverage. On XBRLFiling, FinVerify achieves 99.8% accepted-claim precision and 97.0% decision accuracy; on FinanceBench-67, it reaches 87.9% accepted-claim precision versus 69.7% for the judge. Improvements are smaller on FinQA and TAT-QA, where authoritative evidence is limited. These results suggest that explicit, evidence-backed verification can improve financial-agent reliability while exposing trade-offs between correctness, false rejection, and abstention.
core_methodology: Evidence-grounded verification framework combining LLM-based claim structuring with deterministic validation checks (temporal, source, comparability, accounting, and financial-model fidelity) and Z3 theorem prover for formula consistency
data_sources: Agent Finance Reasoning dataset, XBRL filings, FinanceBench-67, FinQA, TAT-QA
alpha_potential: Potential to improve reliability of automated financial analysis pipelines by reducing calculation errors (11-20 ppt precision improvement demonstrated) from common financial reporting pitfalls, though impact on direct trading signals is indirect
title_cn: FinVerify：金融智能体的验证框架
summary_cn: 该研究提出的FinVerify框架通过结合大语言模型与确定性验证规则(Z3验证器)，系统检测金融计算中的五类常见错误(时间完整性、数据源可信度等)，在XBRL文件等结构化数据场景中实现99.8%的声明精确度，可提升自动化财务分析管道的可靠性，间接保障量化策略中财务因子计算的质量。

title: Conditional Diffusion Models for Amortized Bayesian System Identification
summary: Generative diffusion models rapidly solve Bayesian inverse problems, such as image restoration and inpainting, with a single trained model and without retraining for each new observation or task. Bayesian system identification, which typically involves inferring the hidden states and parameters of a dynamical system from measurements, poses a closely related inverse problem. Yet it is often addressed with computationally heavy Monte Carlo methods that must be rerun for every new measurement record. Moreover, these methods are restricted to a single inference task, and their cost grows with the state dimension and the record length. To alleviate these restrictions, we interpret Bayesian system identification in hiddem Markov models (HMMs) as a general Bayesian inverse problem, taking advantage of conditional diffusion models. Specifically, a transformer-based diffusion model is trained once on short segments of simulated trajectories to approximate the joint posterior of states and parameters. Through an attention mask induced by the Markov property and a relative time encoding, it can then be deployed on any new measurement record of custom length. At inference time, the same model can flexibly and rapidly be conditioned for joint state and parameter inference, state smoothing, parameter inference, or reconstructing missing measurements, without retraining. We demonstrate these capabilities on four benchmark systems and examine how the length of the training segments affects state and parameter inference. On records five times longer than the training segments, the model maintains its state accuracy, whereas comparison methods either show a more than tenfold error increase or require ten times as much sampling time.
core_methodology: The paper introduces a transformer-based conditional diffusion model for amortized Bayesian system identification in hidden Markov models (HMMs). It leverages simulated trajectories for training and can be applied to new measurement records of varying lengths without retraining, enabling flexible inference tasks such as state smoothing and parameter estimation.
data_sources: Simulated trajectories of dynamical systems, which could be analogous to simulated financial time series data.
alpha_potential: The methodology could be adapted for financial time series analysis, such as inferring latent market states or parameters from noisy observations, potentially improving trading signals or risk management strategies.
title_cn: 用于摊销贝叶斯系统识别的条件扩散模型
summary_cn: 该论文提出了一种基于Transformer的条件扩散模型，用于隐藏马尔可夫模型中的贝叶斯系统识别。该方法通过模拟时间序列数据进行训练，无需重新训练即可灵活应用于不同长度的新观测记录，适用于状态平滑、参数估计等多种推断任务，可能在金融市场时间序列分析中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Markov-Equivalent Conditional Independence Graphs on Path Spaces
summary: Causal discovery for continuous-time stochastic processes with latent confounding typically faces a trade-off between (i) approaches that are highly informative about the causal structure but are difficult to test statistically, and (ii) approaches that admit practical tests from data but yield more coarse-grained conclusions, potentially not leveraging the direction of time. We introduce W-separation, an asymmetric graphical criterion for directed mixed graphs defined as a quaternary relation that allows distinct conditioning on past and future components. This added flexibility yields a highly informative graphical independence model while preserving testability. W-separation satisfies a global Markov property for a broad class of stochastic differential equations with latent confounding, linking it to conditional independence relations among coordinate processes that are testable from data. A central result of this work is the full characterization of W-Markov equivalence classes: we show that every equivalence class admits a unique greatest element that serves as a canonical representative and a principled target for learning algorithms. In addition, we provide necessary and sufficient conditions under which directed or bidirected edges can be added without altering the induced independence model.
core_methodology: Introduces W-separation, an asymmetric graphical criterion for directed mixed graphs that enables distinct conditioning on past and future components in continuous-time stochastic processes, with applications to causal discovery in the presence of latent confounding.
data_sources: Theoretical framework applicable to any continuous-time financial data, such as high-frequency trading data, limit order books, or multivariate time series of asset prices.
alpha_potential: Potential to improve causal inference in financial markets, enabling better identification of lead-lag relationships and causal factors in price movements, which could be valuable for high-frequency trading strategies or portfolio construction.
title_cn: 路径空间上的马尔可夫等价条件独立图
summary_cn: 本文提出了W-分离方法，一种用于连续时间随机过程的因果发现技术，特别适用于存在潜在混杂因子的情况。该方法通过区分对过去和未来组件的条件处理，提高了因果结构的识别精度。在金融交易中，这种方法可帮助更准确地识别资产价格间的领先-滞后关系和真实因果因素，为高频交易策略和组合优化提供更可靠的理论基础。

title: From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency compared with RecursiveMAS. It also supports diverse collaboration patterns by representing their topologies as adjacency matrices. These results demonstrate the potential of convolutional co-evolution for efficient multi-agent self-improvement. Our code and datasets are provided in https://github.com/LYA2333/ConvRSI.
core_methodology: ConvRSI framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through intra-agent and inter-agent graph convolutions in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeated decoding/encoding
data_sources: Evaluated on MATH-500 dataset (mathematical problem-solving tasks), though methodology is abstract enough to potentially adapt to financial data
alpha_potential: Potential application in multi-agent trading systems where parallel coordination across diverse strategies/signals is needed. The convolution approach could help manage dependencies between trading signals/algorithms more efficiently than recursive methods
title_cn: 从递归到卷积：多智能体系统的并行自改进方法
summary_cn: ConvRSI框架通过潜在空间中的卷积运算实现多智能体并行协同优化，相比递归方法减少45%延迟并提升性能。该技术可应用于高频交易中多个策略代理的并行协同决策，解决传统串行优化带来的延迟问题，特别适合需要快速协调多种市场信号的应用场景。

title: Hilbert States for Decision-Making under Partial Observability
summary: Decision-making under partial observability can be fundamentally limited by information, even with known dynamics: distinct physical states can induce the same observation history while favoring different actions. We study three questions: when is full-state optimality unattainable, what information exactly preserves the best observation-based decision, and how does finite-data learning affect reliability? First, we characterize decision ambiguity through conditional action preferences. We give a zero-regret criterion, a positive lower bound for conflicting uniquely optimal actions on positive-probability regions with uniformly positive cost gaps, and an exact binary-action regret formula. This also shows why physical-state ambiguity alone need not cause decision loss. Second, for two actions and squared terminal-goal costs in the plane, we derive an exact inner-product representation of conditional expected cost differences using three conditional moment contrasts and a goal-dependent feature. This Hilbert state preserves observation-optimal actions without hidden-state reconstruction. Under nondegenerate history and goal variation, its three-dimensional form is minimal among exact bilinear cost-contrast representations. Third, we relate finite-data state errors to excess decision regret via goal-projected errors, action margins, and goal geometry. Physics-based simulations verify information-limited regret, exact action preservation, and the role of second moments. Held-out real-SAR experiments demonstrate feasible goal-conditioned decisions from masked images, while finite-data evaluations reveal goal-dependent reliability. Together, these results separate irreducible information loss, exact representation sufficiency, and learning-induced excess regret.
core_methodology: The paper introduces Hilbert states for decision-making under partial observability, focusing on conditional action preferences and exact inner-product representations of conditional expected cost differences. It provides theoretical guarantees for optimal decision-making without full-state reconstruction and analyzes finite-data learning effects on reliability.
data_sources: While not explicitly mentioned, the methodology could theoretically be applied to financial time-series data or other partially observable market datasets. The real-SAR experiments suggest feasibility with masked images, implying potential application to processed market data.
alpha_potential: The framework could help develop more robust trading strategies in partially observable environments (like incomplete market data) by optimally acting on observable information without needing full state reconstruction. Particularly relevant for high-frequency trading or situations with data gaps.
title_cn: 用于部分可观测性下决策的希尔伯特状态
summary_cn: 本文提出的希尔伯特状态方法可在金融市场部分信息可观测时（如高频数据缺失）保持决策最优性，无需完全状态重构。其条件行动偏好理论和精确成本差异表示可能提升交易策略在数据不完整情况下的稳健性，特别适合处理市场微观结构数据中的观测限制问题。

title: Searching for Autoregressive Neural Architectures from Fundamental Operations
summary: Expressive Neural Architecture Search (NAS) search spaces are desirable as they do not restrict the space of potential architectures to what is already established. However, few search spaces are expressive enough to represent a broad range of architecture families, and those that are have focused primarily on image classification problems. The task of autoregressive sequence modelling has become ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but no existing search space supports the construction of and search over sequence models from fundamental operations, instead imposing strong inductive biases on the structure of potential architectures. This work describes how the expressive einspace search space can be extended to yield a search space capable of representing autoregressive models using fundamental operations. We perform a series of experiments showing that the novel einspaceAR search space can find capable autoregressive sequence models from scratch--i.e., without imposing strong inductive biases. We believe that our einspaceAR search space will be a useful part of the NAS toolbox and that the techniques described in this work can serve as a blueprint for the integration of autoregressive modelling in other expressive search spaces.
core_methodology: The paper introduces einspaceAR, an extension of the einspace search space for Neural Architecture Search (NAS), specifically designed for autoregressive sequence modeling. It allows for the construction and search over sequence models from fundamental operations without imposing strong inductive biases on the architecture structure.
data_sources: The abstract does not specify particular data sources, but the methodology is applicable to any sequential data, which could include financial time series data in trading applications.
alpha_potential: The approach could potentially uncover novel autoregressive models that outperform existing architectures in predicting financial time series, leading to improved trading signals or risk management strategies. However, the abstract does not demonstrate specific financial applications.
title_cn: 从基本操作中搜索自回归神经架构
summary_cn: 本文提出了einspaceAR，一种扩展的神经架构搜索空间，专门用于自回归序列建模。该方法能够从基本操作中构建和搜索序列模型，而不对架构结构施加强归纳偏置。在量化交易中，这种技术可能帮助发现优于现有架构的新模型，用于金融时间序列预测，从而改进交易信号或风险管理策略。

title: Cap-Aware Boosting for Green Day-Ahead Electricity Price Forecasting
summary: Accurate forecasting of Green Day-Ahead Market (GDAM) electricity prices is essential for market participants in the Indian power sector. We present a LightGBM-based forecasting framework for Indian Energy Exchange GDAM prices, which clear in 96 fifteen-minute intervals per day. The proposed system explicitly models price-cap behavior by separating capped-price events from normal market conditions. A classification head estimates the probability of the regulatory price cap (Rs 10,000/MWh), while a regression head predicts uncapped prices in logarithmic space. Final forecasts are obtained through probabilistic blending of these components and are accompanied by nine quantile forecasts for uncertainty estimation. Evaluated on 257 trading days between 1 January and 14 September 2026, the model achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 397.9 Rs/MWh and a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 9.57%, substantially outperforming a Chronos-2 baseline (583.3 MAE) and a persistence baseline using the previous day's profile (589.1 MAE). We further introduce leak-safe variants that incorporate real-time market signals, unmatched sell volumes, and solar generation proxies. In a recent out-of-sample evaluation, the quantile-clock variant achieved the best short-term performance with an MAE of 789 Rs/MWh during 25-28 October, while the enhanced capped-price model achieved an MAE of 716 Rs/MWh across 21 evaluation days through 16 November. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of regime-aware probabilistic forecasting for high-volatility electricity markets.
core_methodology: LightGBM-based forecasting framework with separate classification and regression heads for modeling price-cap behavior, probabilistic blending of components, and quantile forecasting for uncertainty estimation.
data_sources: Indian Energy Exchange Green Day-Ahead Market (GDAM) prices, real-time market signals, unmatched sell volumes, and solar generation proxies.
alpha_potential: The model captures regime-specific behavior in high-volatility electricity markets, particularly price-cap events, which can be exploited for trading strategies in energy markets. The probabilistic approach provides uncertainty estimates valuable for risk management.
title_cn: 基于上限感知增强的绿色日前电价预测
summary_cn: 该研究提出了一种针对印度能源交易所绿色日前市场的LightGBM预测框架，通过分离价格上限事件与正常市场条件，结合分类和回归模型进行概率混合预测，并生成分位数预测以量化不确定性。在257个交易日测试中显著优于基准模型，展示了在高波动性能源市场中基于机制识别的预测有效性。

title: In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs
summary: Transformers have demonstrated the ability to perform in-context learning, that is, to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without updating their parameters. Existing theory has largely focused on emulating gradient-based algorithms for convex statistical problems or establishing general function approximation guarantees without exploiting the underlying statistical structure. We study in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where estimation is generally nonconvex. Under suitable identifiability and regularity conditions, we construct a transformer that estimates unknown system parameters from noisy trajectory observations through a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure: a coarse search provides an initialization within a locally strongly convex region, followed by gradient descent with local linear contraction. For prediction, we compose this estimator with a neural approximation of the ODE solution map. We further show that, through parameter sharing, a single transformer can perform both parameter estimation and trajectory prediction simultaneously. For these constructions, we establish nonasymptotic guarantees and finite-pretraining oracle inequalities that separate errors due to finite pretraining data, finite context length, and finite-sized transformer approximation. Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear ODEs further show that pretrained transformers can benefit from longer inference contexts without updating their weights.
core_methodology: The paper presents a transformer-based approach to in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs). It utilizes a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure, combining coarse search with gradient descent, followed by neural approximation of the ODE solution map.
data_sources: No specific financial data is mentioned, but the methodology could be applied to time-series data from financial markets (e.g., price movements, volatility patterns, or other market dynamics modeled as ODEs).
alpha_potential: Potential applications include modeling and predicting financial time-series data, where ODEs could represent underlying market dynamics. The transformer's ability to adapt to new tasks from few examples could be useful for quick adaptation to changing market conditions.
title_cn: 基于上下文估计与预测的参数化常微分方程方法
summary_cn: 本研究提出基于Transformer的上下文学习方法，用于参数化常微分方程的参数估计与轨迹预测。该方法通过两阶段近似极大似然估计，可快速适应新的微分方程系统，在金融时序预测领域有潜在应用价值，特别是对需要快速适应市场状态变化的交易策略开发具有启示意义。

title: Wavelet-Energy-Driven Dynamic Patching for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Patch-based transformers tokenise a time series into fixed-size, uniform windows, which commits the model to a single temporal resolution even though real signals are multi-scale. The discrete wavelet transform (DWT) is a natural alternative because it decomposes a signal across scales. A growing body of work makes the wavelet filter learnable, on the assumption that a more flexible wavelet forecasts better. That assumption has rarely been tested in isolation, because a single reported improvement usually credits three things at once. These are the use of any multi-resolution decomposition, the choice of wavelet and training the filter. We introduce a forecaster that turns a learnable-DWT per-scale energy map into variable-length patches by merging adjacent windows that share a dominant scale. Three findings follow. First, most of the improvement is there before any filter is learned. A frozen wavelet beats a fixed-patch baseline on eight of the nine datasets by 1.5% to 7.8%, and on four of them it recovers all of the gain. Traffic is the one exception, where it is 1.2% worse. Second, learning the filter gives a further improvement on only some datasets. It helps on three of the nine datasets and makes Traffic 2.7% worse. Third, having variable-length patches helps, but exactly where their boundaries fall does not. A fixed-size uniform grid, even with its patch size tuned per task, is worse than our variable-length patches on 27 of 36 settings. Recomputing the boundaries from the learned filter at every step, rather than caching them once, never helps. The improvement in wavelet-based forecasting comes from the multi-resolution structure and the variable-length patches it induces, not from making the wavelet learnable. In practice, start from any valid wavelet, cache the patch boundaries once and treat training the filter as a per-dataset decision rather than a default.
core_methodology: Uses wavelet transform to create dynamic, variable-length patches for time series forecasting, comparing frozen vs. learned wavelets and fixed vs. variable patch boundaries
data_sources: Nine different datasets (one being Traffic data), suggesting potential applicability to financial time series
alpha_potential: Multi-scale time series analysis could improve forecasting of financial instruments where signals operate at different frequencies (e.g., high-frequency vs. daily data)
title_cn: 基于小波能量驱动的动态分块方法在时间序列预测中的应用
summary_cn: 该研究提出一种利用小波能量动态调整时间序列分块大小的创新方法，优于传统固定分块方式。研究证明小波的多尺度特性（而非参数学习）是关键改进来源，这对金融市场的多频率信号分析（如结合高频与日间数据）具有潜在价值。

title: Warm Starting Neural Dynamics Models From Few Jacobian Samples
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) leverages a model of the environment, used for planning and generating samples without interacting with the real world. Motivated by evidence that informed initialization significantly improves the efficiency of MBRL, we propose TDec-Init, an algorithm to warm-start neural dynamics models using transition Jacobians. Using a decoupling algorithm based on the decomposition of a tensor of stacked Jacobian samples, we recover weights and flexible nonlinearities, and use them to initialize a feedforward neural network. In the low-data regime, we show on several benchmark environments that our approach outperforms random initialization and value training, and either matches or outperforms Sobolev training, while requiring fewer training steps between episodes.
core_methodology: Proposes TDec-Init algorithm to warm-start neural dynamics models using transition Jacobians, employing tensor decomposition to recover weights and initialize feedforward neural networks for model-based reinforcement learning.
data_sources: Benchmark environments (simulated data), no explicit market data mentioned
alpha_potential: Could potentially improve efficiency of RL-based trading strategies by reducing training time in low-data regimes, though requires adaptation to financial time series
title_cn: 基于少量雅可比样本的热启动神经动力学模型
summary_cn: 本研究提出的TDec-Init算法通过分解雅可比样本张量来初始化神经网络，在低数据环境下显著提升模型效率。该方法可潜在优化量化交易中基于强化学习的策略开发流程，缩短模型训练时间，特别是在市场结构变化后的快速适应性调整场景中具有应用前景。

title: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
summary: A useful memory need not resemble the question it helps answer. Jetriever ranks each stored memory by Jev's decision score for its usefulness to the current question, replacing similarity search with full-pool utility scoring. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, it places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases; matched BM25 and MiniLM controls reach 1.6% and 0.0% when indexing user turns. A 20-question comparison separates finding evidence from ranking it: Jev and Qwen3.5 9B each find 90% of gold exchanges by rank 50, while Laya finds 30%; at rank one, Jev reaches 85% and Qwen3.5 9B 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever's four-dimension score is 55.4%, against 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions. Jev retrieval costs USD 0.00834 per InMind question and USD 0.03103 per MAB question on average. These results show the value of world knowledge, scores that rank decisive memories first, and affordable full-pool scoring.
core_methodology: Jetriever introduces a utility-based memory retrieval system that ranks stored memories by their decision score for usefulness to the current question, replacing traditional similarity search methods. This approach leverages Jev's decision score to prioritize decisive memories, demonstrating superior performance in retrieving relevant information compared to similarity-based methods like BM25 and MiniLM.
data_sources: The paper evaluates the methodology on InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks and a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, focusing on retrieval performance rather than specific financial data.
alpha_potential: The utility-based retrieval approach could enhance trading strategies by improving the relevance and timeliness of information retrieval in dynamic market conditions. This could be particularly valuable for high-frequency trading or algorithmic strategies that rely on rapid, accurate information processing.
title_cn: Jetriever：将代理记忆检索从相似性转向实用性
summary_cn: Jetriever通过基于实用性的记忆检索系统，取代传统的相似性搜索，显著提高了信息检索的准确性和效率。该方法在金融交易中可能提升高频交易和算法策略的信息处理能力，具有潜在的应用价值。

title: Reading or Remembering? Measuring Temporal Contamination in Language Models
summary: Language models are now used to read central-bank text for economic forecasting, but most were trained on text written after the documents they read. A model reading a 2021 FOMC statement may already know that inflation rose in 2022, so part of its apparent skill can be memory of the outcome, a temporal form of test-set contamination. We measure this memory on FOMC statements and minutes from 2000 to 2026 by comparing modern open models with chronologically consistent models, which are trained only on text from before a fixed date. Asked about past GDP outcomes given only a date, models that cannot know the answer still reach an AUC of up to 0.64 from priors on dates and eras, so chance is the wrong baseline. Against these memory-free models on the same questions, most modern models recall which years had strong growth. Membership-inference scores sort documents by era and document type rather than by whether a model saw them, as exact counts in an open pretraining corpus show. In real-time nowcasts, every lookahead premium we estimate on US GDP is smaller than the forecast comparison can detect at macroeconomic sample sizes, and none on GDP or inflation survives correction for multiple testing. Lookahead audits should therefore measure memory directly against memory-free models on the same items.
core_methodology: The paper introduces a method to measure temporal contamination in language models by comparing modern models with chronologically consistent models that are trained only on text from before a fixed date. This methodology helps identify whether a model's performance is due to actual understanding or mere memory of future events.
data_sources: The study uses FOMC statements and minutes from 2000 to 2026 as primary data sources, along with general text data for training language models.
alpha_potential: The paper highlights the importance of ensuring that models used for economic forecasting are not contaminated by future knowledge. This could be valuable in developing more reliable models for macroeconomic nowcasting and trading strategies that depend on accurate interpretation of central bank communications.
title_cn: 阅读还是记忆？测量语言模型中的时间污染
summary_cn: 该研究评估了语言模型在解读美联储文本时是否存在时间污染问题，即模型可能因训练数据包含未来信息而产生记忆效应。这对量化交易中依赖宏观经济预测的模型具有重要参考价值，尤其是在处理央行文本时需要考虑时间污染带来的偏差。

title: Severe but Harmless: Stress-Testing Shift Severity for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
summary: Zero-shot time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have become attractive alternatives to task-specific models because they handle diverse downstream tasks, including anomaly detection and forecasting, without per-series training. However, time-series data undergo distribution shifts, and the dissimilarity between two regimes is commonly scored with statistical measures such as Wasserstein-1, where a higher score is read as a more severe shift. In systematic experiments using three established severity measures on nine regime shifts from three standard traffic datasets, we show that these measures do not reliably predict degradation for instance-normalized TSFMs. The regimes rated most severe are not the regimes that degrade the models most, and degradation reaches 29% in the lowest-scoring regime. In most cases, the audit shows no positive relationship between measured severity and model degradation. We provide an equivariance-based stress-testing analysis that explains why severity readings can become decoupled from model degradation.
core_methodology: The paper investigates the relationship between statistical measures of distribution shift severity (e.g., Wasserstein-1) and model degradation in time-series foundation models (TSFMs) under different regime shifts. It provides an equivariance-based stress-testing analysis to explain the decoupling between measured severity and actual model performance degradation.
data_sources: Three standard traffic datasets, which are commonly used in time-series analysis but not financial data.
alpha_potential: The findings could be relevant for developing more robust time-series forecasting models in financial markets, where regime shifts are common. Understanding the decoupling between statistical shift measures and model degradation could help in creating more adaptive models for financial time-series data.
title_cn: 严重但无害：对冻结时间序列预测器的转移严重性进行压力测试
summary_cn: 本文研究了时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在不同制度转移下统计严重性度量（如Wasserstein-1）与模型性能退化之间的关系。通过基于等方差性的压力测试分析，解释了测量严重性与实际模型退化之间的脱钩现象。这一发现对金融时间序列预测模型的稳健性改进具有潜在价值，尤其是在市场制度转移频繁的背景下。

title: Generalization Bounds for Neural Networks with Sparse Connectivity
summary: Empirical evidence suggests that large neural networks rarely make effective use of all available parameters, with learned solutions exhibiting pronounced sparsity. Despite this ubiquity, existing generalization theory only partially explains how such sparsity influences statistical performance. In this paper, we derive non-asymptotic generalization gap bounds for deep neural networks whose layer-wise weight matrices are restricted by $\ell_p$ quasi-norm ($0<p\leq 1$) constraints. Our analysis gives rise to a novel result that interpolates between classical norm-based generalization guarantees and parameter-counting bounds. Remarkably, in the extreme sparsity limit as the quasi-norm order $p$ approaches zero, our analysis reveals a transition to a square-root dependence on the number of \emph{active} (non-zero) parameters, resulting in bounds that are strictly tighter than existing parameter-counting approaches. Experiments demonstrate that our bounds exhibit a milder dependence on initial architectural choice at the over-parametrization regime, effectively capturing the generalization benefit of the sparsity arising from training on natural data.
core_methodology: The paper presents generalization bounds for deep neural networks with sparse connectivity, specifically those restricted by ℓp quasi-norm constraints. The analysis provides non-asymptotic bounds that interpolate between classical norm-based generalization and parameter-counting approaches.
data_sources: The paper does not specify financial data sources, focusing instead on theoretical analysis of neural network sparsity, likely applicable to various types of data.
alpha_potential: The theoretical framework could be beneficial in developing more robust neural network models for trading by leveraging sparsity to improve generalization, potentially leading to more stable trading strategies. However, direct alpha generation requires empirical validation with financial data.
title_cn: 具有稀疏连接的神经网络的泛化界限
summary_cn: 该论文研究了稀疏连接的深度神经网络的泛化界限，提出了基于ℓp准范数约束的非渐近泛化误差边界。这一理论框架对金融领域的神经网络交易模型有潜在价值，通过改进稀疏性和泛化能力，可能增强量化策略的稳定性。但需在实际交易数据上验证。

title: Tight Sequential Confidence Intervals for Online Kernel Regression
summary: We characterize, in the worst case over kernels, the sharp minimax width of online confidence intervals for elements of a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). This resolves the open problem posed by Vakili et al. (2021) in its original discrete-time form. A learner observes $y_i=f(x_i)+\epsilon_i$ at adaptively chosen points, with $\|f\|_{\mathcal H_k}\le B$ and i.i.d. $R$-sub-Gaussian noise, and reports the interval $|f(x)-\mu_n(x)|\le\rho_n(\delta)\sigma_n(x)$, where $\mu_n$ and $\sigma_n$ are the posterior mean and standard deviation of a surrogate Gaussian process model with regularization parameter $\lambda$. Writing $\rho_n^*(\delta)$ for the minimax confidence width for a fixed kernel, we show that, for the sum of a linear kernel and a periodic Sobolev kernel, all sufficiently large $n$, and all $\delta\in(0,1/4]$, $\rho_n^*(\delta)\asymp B+(R/\lambda)\sqrt{\gamma_n+\log(1/\delta)}$, where $\gamma_n$ is the maximal information gain and grows polynomially in $n$. Building on Lattimore (2023), we construct an adaptive design on a fixed two-dimensional domain for which, under Gaussian noise, the normalized error at a prespecified point is $\Omega(B+(R/\lambda)\sqrt{\gamma_n})$ with constant probability. This rules out the conjectured polylogarithmic width in the worst case over kernels and online designs.
core_methodology: The paper presents a method for constructing tight sequential confidence intervals for online kernel regression, which involves using a surrogate Gaussian process model with regularization. The approach is characterized by worst-case analysis over kernels and adaptively chosen data points.
data_sources: The methodology is general and can be applied to any sequential data, including financial time series where the observations are noisy and the underlying function is in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS).
alpha_potential: The method could be useful for online learning in algorithmic trading, particularly in scenarios where confidence intervals around predictions are crucial for risk management and decision-making. However, the direct application to generating alpha is not immediately clear and would require additional research to adapt the methodology to specific trading strategies.
title_cn: 在线核回归的紧致序贯置信区间
summary_cn: 本文提出了一种在线核回归的紧致序贯置信区间构建方法，适用于金融时间序列分析。该方法通过高斯过程模型和正则化参数，在自适应选择的数据点上提供置信区间，对算法交易中的风险管理和决策具有潜在应用价值。

title: Sharp Gaussian Approximation for Q-Learning
summary: Gaussian approximation provides a foundation for online statistical inference in reinforcement learning. We establish sharp non-asymptotic Gaussian approximation rates in Wasserstein distance for asynchronous Q-learning with Polyak-Ruppert averaging. We prove an upper bound of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/4})$, where $n$ is the number of iterations, together with a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Q-learning is more challenging to analyze than linear stochastic approximation due to the nonlinearity of the Bellman operator. Asynchronous updates introduce further challenges due to Markovian noise. Our analysis separates the errors from Bellman nonlinearity, Markovian noise, and the finite-sample covariance discrepancy. In particular, we show that Markovian noise induces an unavoidable bias even when the Bellman operator is linear. The trade-off between this bias and the covariance discrepancy determines the convergence rate. We further extend our analysis to the synchronous setting and establish a sharp rate of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/2})$.
core_methodology: Non-asymptotic Gaussian approximation for Q-learning with Polyak-Ruppert averaging, analyzing both asynchronous and synchronous settings with focus on error separation from Bellman nonlinearity and Markovian noise
data_sources: Theoretical study applicable to reinforcement learning environments, not specific to financial markets (financial data would need to be integrated)
alpha_potential: Provides theoretical foundation for stable RL-based trading algorithms by quantifying approximation errors. Could help design more robust Q-learning variants for optimal execution or dynamic portfolio optimization
title_cn: Q学习的高斯逼近理论
summary_cn: 该论文建立了Q学习算法的非渐进高斯逼近理论，特别是对于带Polyak-Ruppert平均的异步Q学习，给出了Wasserstein距离下的收敛速率上界꟨下界。研究分离了贝尔曼非线性、马尔可夫噪声等误差源，对设计稳健的强化学习交易策略（如最优执行算法）提供了理论基础。

title: Washout-free synchronization, parameter estimation and uncertainty quantification of echo state networks
summary: Echo state networks (ESNs) forecast chaotic systems for several Lyapunov times. Like all recurrent networks, ESNs require a washout before forecasting, i.e., a phase in which the full state drives the network until the reservoir state synchronizes with the system. At deployment, however, sensors measure only part of the state, with noise and at a lower sampling rate than the training data. We propose a washout-free deployment of ESNs via ensemble data assimilation. In closed loop, the ESN is a Markovian dynamical system; hence, a sequential filter can correct its reservoir state whenever data are available. The filter synchronizes an ensemble of reservoir states, drawn from the training data, with the system, and quantifies the forecast uncertainty. We extend the method to parametric ESNs, to infer physical parameters, and to parallel ESNs with localization, to forecast high-dimensional systems. We test the method on the Lorenz-63 and Lorenz-96 systems. First, the filter synchronizes the ESN with a fraction of the data of a washout. Second, the filter deploys one full-state ESN from a subset of its components, which a washout cannot do. Third, the filter estimates a forcing that is not in the training data, and the estimated forcing lengthens the forecast. Fourth, localization synchronizes a parallel ESN with eight times fewer members than the global filter. Fifth, the ensemble spread signals, without the true state, when the ESN synchronizes and when the filter fails. This work enables the deployment of ESNs from partial, sparse and noisy observations.
core_methodology: The paper proposes a washout-free deployment of Echo State Networks (ESNs) using ensemble data assimilation. This method allows ESNs to synchronize with chaotic systems from partial, noisy, and sparse observations without requiring a washout phase. The approach includes parameter estimation, uncertainty quantification, and localization for high-dimensional systems.
data_sources: The methodology is tested on synthetic chaotic systems (Lorenz-63 and Lorenz-96), which are commonly used as benchmarks in dynamical systems research. The approach is designed to work with partial, noisy, and sparse observations, which could be analogous to real-world financial data.
alpha_potential: The method's ability to forecast chaotic systems from partial and noisy data could be adapted to financial time series forecasting, where market data often exhibits chaotic behavior and is subject to noise and missing data. The uncertainty quantification feature is particularly valuable for risk management in trading strategies.
title_cn: 无冲刷同步、参数估计和回声状态网络的不确定性量化
summary_cn: 该研究提出了一种无冲刷的回声状态网络（ESN）部署方法，通过集成数据同化技术，使ESN能够从部分、噪声和稀疏的观测中同步混沌系统。该方法在金融时间序列预测中具有潜在应用价值，特别是在处理噪声和缺失数据时，其不确定性量化功能对交易策略的风险管理尤为重要。

title: The Manifold-Index Model: provably and efficiently avoiding the statistical and computational curse of dimensionality
summary: We study vector-valued regression with predictors filling a tube around an unknown $m$-dimensional manifold $\mathcal{M}$ in $\mathbb{R}^D$. In the Manifold-Index Model, the mean response is $F=f\circ\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$, where $\Pi_{\mathcal{M}}$ is the nearest-point projection onto $\mathcal{M}$ and $f:\mathcal{M}\to\mathbb{R}^p$ is a possibly non-injective link function. Multiscale ANisotropic lOcal Regression (MANOR) estimates tangent planes by multiscale PCA of predictors with similar responses, then refines them by pooling outer products of local slopes. The neighborhoods narrow tangentially while retaining complete normal fibers. We assume a Lipschitz link differential and bounded response noise. For $p\ge m$, under our geometric and sampling conditions, $n$ independent observations give mean tangent-space error of order $n^{-2/(m+4)}$ and integrated squared prediction error at the $m$-dimensional nonparametric rate $n^{-4/(m+4)}$, up to logarithmic factors. In a scaling regime with fixed intrinsic dimension, model and scale parameters, and ratio of manifold volume to the $m$-th power of its reach, the required sample size grows polynomially in $D+p$, and computation is polynomial in $n$, $D$ and $p$. Numerical experiments on curves with non-monotone links and surfaces with vector-valued responses compare observed convergence rates with the theoretical bounds; a Langevin dynamics example tests prediction of hitting probabilities under an approximate manifold-index model.
core_methodology: The paper introduces the Manifold-Index Model and Multiscale ANisotropic lOcal Regression (MANOR) for vector-valued regression on high-dimensional data. It focuses on estimating tangent planes using multiscale PCA and refining them with local slopes, addressing the curse of dimensionality.
data_sources: The methodology can be applied to high-dimensional financial data, such as asset returns, volatility surfaces, or order book dynamics, where predictors lie near a low-dimensional manifold.
alpha_potential: The method's ability to handle high-dimensional data efficiently could help uncover latent patterns or inefficiencies in financial markets, particularly in scenarios where traditional dimensionality reduction techniques fail.
title_cn: 流形索引模型：理论上高效避免维数灾难的统计和计算
summary_cn: 该论文提出的流形索引模型和MANOR方法，通过多尺度PCA和局部斜率估计，有效处理高维数据中的回归问题。在金融领域，可应用于高维市场数据（如资产收益、波动率曲面等）的降维和模式识别，有助于发现潜在的市场低效或交易信号。

title: Near-Optimal Methods for Generalized Lipschitz Convex Optimization
summary: In this paper, we consider a convex optimization problem, where the upper bound on the subgradient norm depends on the objective function. We establish a lower bound on the number of iterations required by any first-order method to find an approximate solution to the problem. Furthermore, we present two near-optimal algorithms that can match the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. The first algorithm is a projected GD with a carefully designed stepsize schedule which incorporates warm-up and decay phases. The second algorithm is scalar-stepsize clipped AdamW which extends the near-optimal guarantees to the stochastic setting, where only a noisy unbiased estimator of the subgradient is available.
core_methodology: This paper presents two sophisticated optimization algorithms for convex problems with generalized Lipschitz conditions. The first is a projected gradient descent with dynamic step size scheduling incorporating warm-up and decay phases. The second extends these guarantees to stochastic settings by introducing a scalar-stepsize version of clipped AdamW, suitable when only noisy subgradient estimates are available.
data_sources: Theoretical framework that could be applied to various financial datasets including returns, volatility measures, or factor exposures where convex optimization is applicable (e.g., portfolio construction, parameter estimation)
alpha_potential: The adaptive step size methodologies could improve parameter optimization in trading strategies (e.g., momentum strategy parameter calibration or portfolio rebalancing algorithms) by providing more stable convergence properties compared to standard approaches
title_cn: 广义Lipschitz凸优化的近最优方法
summary_cn: 本文提出两种新型优化算法：带动态步长调节的投影梯度下降法和改进型AdamW算法，适用于金融领域中的参数优化问题（如因子权重计算、投资组合构建）。其自适应步长特性可提升策略回测稳定性，但需结合实际交易数据进行效果验证。

title: Generalized Prediction Set with Bandit Feedback
summary: In high-stakes environments where uncertainties abound, set-valued prediction offers a cautious and robust mechanism by presenting multiple potential labels as the prediction for each test instance to mitigate the potential risk associated with prediction errors. Yet, integrating this paradigm with out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains scarcely explored in such settings as online learning with bandit feedback. The bandit feedback mechanism informs the learner about the correctness of the pulled arm/action instead of the explicit ground truth label, leaving the true class label unknown when an incorrect action is taken. To address this challenge, we introduce BanditGPS which conducts set-valued prediction with OOD detection in the bandit feedback setting, using an estimation to the ground truth of class labels. BanditGPS achieves three objectives: render small/informative prediction sets, enhance the OOD detection performance, and control the recall for all normal classes to meet prescribed requirements. Our approach is characterized by the loss function, which trades off between high OOD detection and small prediction sets. Theoretically, we prove that the convergence rate of the regret is $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-1/2})$. The empirical results further show that BanditGPS effectively controls the recalls with promising performances on OOD detection and informative prediction.
core_methodology: BanditGPS introduces a set-valued prediction method with OOD detection in bandit feedback settings, using an estimation of ground truth labels. It focuses on trading off between high OOD detection and small prediction sets through a specialized loss function.
data_sources: The paper does not specify particular financial data sources but the methodology is applicable to any scenario with bandit feedback, such as online trading or portfolio selection where only the correctness of the action is known.
alpha_potential: The method's ability to handle uncertainty and OOD detection could be valuable in algorithmic trading for risk management and adaptive strategy adjustment, particularly in volatile or non-stationary markets.
title_cn: 基于老虎机反馈的广义预测集
summary_cn: BanditGPS提出了一种在老虎机反馈设置下进行集值预测和OOD检测的方法，通过估计真实标签来平衡高OOD检测和小预测集。该方法在算法交易中具有潜在应用价值，特别是在需要处理不确定性和非平稳市场的风险管理和策略调整方面。

title: Compressed Simulation-Based Inference: Neural Posterior Estimation for Massive Data via Low-Dimensional Sketches
summary: Neural posterior estimation (NPE) is a popular Bayesian simulation-based inference (SBI) approach that uses neural networks trained on simulated data--parameter pairs to approximate the posterior given a user-chosen prior. For high-dimensional observations, NPE methods typically approximate the conditional density of the parameter given a user-chosen or learned summary statistic, rather than the entire dataset, due to the curse of dimensionality. However, both approaches face challenges: hand-crafting good summaries for complex models requires considerable effort from scientists, while learning them from massive datasets can be prohibitively computationally expensive. To address these challenges, we propose approximating the conditional density of a parameter given low-dimensional sketches of the data. We show that, for a model with a $p$-dimensional parameter, only $2p+1$ random sketches are needed for posterior consistency. We compare with state-of-the-art embedding networks for NPE, and we find that our method \emph{matches} the best embedding network's performance while \emph{increasing computational efficiency}.
core_methodology: Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) using low-dimensional sketches of high-dimensional data to approximate Bayesian posteriors efficiently, particularly useful for models with massive datasets where traditional methods are computationally expensive.
data_sources: The methodology is data-agnostic but would be applicable to high-dimensional financial datasets (e.g., tick data, order books, or alternative data streams). No specific market data is mentioned in the abstract.
alpha_potential: Potential to improve high-frequency trading strategies, volatility estimation, or portfolio construction where efficient Bayesian inference on massive datasets is required. Could help extract signals from complex, high-dimension market data more efficiently than traditional methods.
title_cn: 基于压缩模拟的推理：通过低维摘要进行海量数据的神经后验估计
summary_cn: 本文提出的低维摘要神经后验估计方法，能高效处理金融高频交易中的海量数据，为量化交易提供更快速的贝叶斯推断方案，在波动率预测和组合优化等场景具有应用潜力。

title: The cost of enforcing long-run coverage: a phase transition in online conformal prediction
summary: Consider an online prediction setting, where at each time, we are given a new feature vector and asked to provide a prediction interval or prediction set that will likely contain the corresponding response. In this setting, if the data points are i.i.d. (or more generally, exchangeable), conformal prediction provides a mechanism for building valid prediction sets around the output of any trained model, offering coverage probability $\geq 1-\alpha$ at each time $t$. In practice, however, issues such as distribution drift, changepoints, or other challenges may cause violations of the i.i.d. assumption. In this adversarial setting, online conformal prediction methods can still offer guarantees on long-run empirical coverage. However, there is a trade-off between these two types of goals: enforcing tight constraints on long-run empirical coverage to protect against the adversarial setting can lead to unstable oscillations in the instantaneous training-conditional coverage in the i.i.d. setting. In this work, we seek best-of-both-worlds algorithms that aim to minimize cumulative error in instantaneous training-conditional coverage when in the i.i.d. setting, while also offering long-run empirical coverage guarantees in the adversarial setting. Specifically, consider a condition that requires long-run empirical coverage to deviate from the target level $1-\alpha$ by at most $\mathcal{O}(T^{-\beta})$, for some $\beta\in[0,1]$. We prove that this family of conditions can be described with a phase transition.
